headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins secured a crucial 7-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Dylan Beavers leading the Orioles' offense and Yaramil Hiraldo impressing on the mound. The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 7-1, with Alec Burleson leading the Phillies' offense. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the Athletics 8-4, led by Liam Hicks' three hits, one home run, and three RBIs. The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Ryan Feltner earning the win and Brett Sullivan leading the Rockies' offense.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Jake Bloss being placed on the 60-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays. Riley Greene has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers due to a right hamstring strain. Kyle Karros has been placed on the 7-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies with a concussion. José Suarez has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Athletics with a right hip strain. Blake Treinen has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Los Angeles Dodgers due to right elbow inflammation. Isiah Kiner-Falefa has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Boston Red Sox. Kervin Castro has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the New York Yankees with right elbow neuritis. Hunter Greene has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Cincinnati Reds due to right elbow soreness.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including Harold Rivas being traded to the Baltimore Orioles from the Boston Red Sox. The Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins outlasted the Baltimore Orioles 7-5, securing a crucial win in their matchup. Dylan Beavers led the Orioles' offense with a home run and three RBIs, while Yaramil Hiraldo impressed on the mound with 1.2 scoreless innings and three strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Burleson led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits, 3 RBIs, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Athletics 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Hicks finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Ryan Feltner earning the win. Brett Sullivan led the Rockies' offense with a home run, three RBIs, and one hit in four at-bats.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays RHP Bloss Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right-handed pitcher Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list, marking a significant update to the team's roster.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
